text:
sam: heads-up: customer reported duplicate onboarding sessions and duplicate billing. quickstart (python) retried on 429 while token refresh was in flight. logs show retry id=null then success.
jon: can you paste the short snippet and sdk version?
sam: python quickstart v0.9.2. snippet: 
```
WARN POST /v1/sessions 429 {"retry_after":0.45}
DEBUG auth refresh start
DEBUG client retry attempt=1 id=null
INFO POST /v1/sessions 201 id=sess_live123
```
ada: this is an unsafe replay: retry + refresh race -> repeated side effects. we need sampleapp + SDK changes.
sahil: agreed. two parts: 1) improve default client retry (exp backoff + full jitter), 2) make sampleapp demonstrate idempotency for mutates. node/go already ship small idempotency helpers; python quickstart lacks parity.
kevin: policy: SDK should NOT silently auto-idempotentize all mutates. default = exp backoff with full jitter + conservative attempts. add opt-in middleware to attach Idempotency-Key for annotated calls. suggested defaults: retry.base_ms=100, retry.max_ms=2000, retry.attempts=5, safe_replay_window_s=10.
jon: sampleapp change request: add helper add_idempotency(headers) and use it on create-session example, plus a one-paragraph onboarding note about token-refresh races and when to use idempotency. include code snippet for header generation.
sahil: can we add an e2e test that simulates 429 during refresh? simple harness: fake auth server delay so initial request gets 429 and client retries during refresh; assert only one session created when idempotency header is present. also add a unit test for backoff jitter distribution.
kevin: i'll take the python parity ticket and design a small API: Client.create_session(..., idempotency_mode='opt-in'|'auto'|'none') where 'opt-in' is default. will RFC it.
ci-bot: created ticket INT-3201 python-sdk-idempotency-parity and PR draft at github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/333
sam: thanks — i'll open the quickstart PR to show the header injection and onboarding blurb, and link it here. tagging for follow-up. :thumbsup:
